summary:
Iter 87 — regression on the 7 flow groups from the review request. Backend: 14/15 pass. Found 2 real spec gaps:
  (A) BACKEND SPEC GAP — /api/follows/{user_id}: FREE user can follow another user without an upgrade gate. Returns 200 instead of 403 upgrade_required. follows_router.follow_org has NO require_interaction(u) call (/app/backend/routers/follows_router.py:108-134).
  (B) MOBILE SPEC GAP — /app/mobile/src/lib/upgrade.ts handleUpgrade() only matches e.status === 402, but require_interaction() in deps.py raises HTTP 403 with the same {code:'upgrade_required'} payload. Web (api.js) already handles both 402 AND 403 — mobile only handles 402. Impact: FREE users on mobile hitting DM / posts / comments / reactions / reviews get a raw error instead of the paywall toast + /pricing redirect.

All other flows verified:
  • Signup: Club/Organization (partner) role works. 18+/guidelines check enforced (400). Password strength rules (8+/upper/digit/special) all enforced (400 for custom validator, 422 for pydantic length). Valid signup returns {user, session_token} with subscription_tier='free'.
  • Pricing /payments/packages: Boat Pro $12.99/$19.99/$29.99 with 0/10%/20% discounts at 1/6/12mo. Sailor+Owner premium $6.99 with 0/10%/15%/20% at 1/3/6/12mo. Totals correct (pro_basic_12 = $124.70). /payments/checkout returns a Stripe test checkout URL + amount. Web /pricing: default tab 'Sailors & Owners' selected, Boat Pros tab shows all 3 tier cards with Featured highlighted, discount pills render correctly.
  • Free DM gating: POST /messages/{id} with free token → 403 {detail:{code:'upgrade_required', message:...}}.
  • Boat Pro: GET /boat-pros/{id} returns {pro, reviews} wrapper with pro.viewer_hired + pro.hire_count. POST /boat-pros/{id}/hire toggles (hired + count). POST /reviews requires 4 category_ratings (personality, skill, promptness, communication) 1..5. PATCH + DELETE /admin/content/review/{id} edit+delete work; review removed from /reviews list.
  • Events: POST /events accepts starts_at/ends_at with 15-min granularity (14:15, 16:45 preserved as +00:00). Backend normalizes trailing Z to +00:00. is_volunteer flag persists. GET /events?market=... supports from/to window. POST /events/{id}/register works. POST /events/{id}/crew for volunteer sign-up. PATCH /events/{id} admin edit persists in list.
  • Community: POST /posts for_sale with price + condition succeeds. POST /posts/{id}/comments. PATCH + DELETE /admin/content/post/{id} edit+delete persist (admin_edited flag added).

Note on event dates during this iteration: system clock is 2026-10-03 so events in Sept 2026 appear in the past and are filtered out by the upcoming-event predicate — I migrated the test to a December 2026 window.

critical.issue: Spec says FREE users should see an upgrade prompt when following a user. Endpoint currently returns 200 and silently follows. follows_router.follow_org (lines 108-134) does NOT call require_interaction(u). Add require_interaction(u) after `u = await _me(...)` to match the DM/post/comment gating pattern.

integration_issues.issue: /app/mobile/src/lib/upgrade.ts:9 only matches e.status === 402, but require_interaction() in /app/backend/deps.py raises HTTP 403 with the same {code:'upgrade_required'} payload. Web lib/api.js handles BOTH 402 and 403. Mobile only handles 402 — users hitting a 403 upgrade_required see a raw ApiError instead of the paywall toast + /pricing redirect. Fix: change condition to `(e.status === 402 || e.status === 403) && e.code === 'upgrade_required'`.

parity_issues.flow: Paywall on gated interactions (DMs, posts, comments, reactions, reviews)
parity_issues.issue: Web handles the 403 upgrade_required branch, mobile only handles 402. Spec in review request literally says '402/403 upgrade_required handled as a toast/banner, NOT a raw error' — mobile currently fails that for every 403 case.
parity_issues.expected: Mobile shows warning toast + routes to /pricing on 403 upgrade_required (same as web).
parity_issues.actual: Mobile falls through to generic error toast.

action_items: BACKEND (HIGH): Add `require_interaction(u)` inside follow_org() in /app/backend/routers/follows_router.py right after the self-follow / blocked checks, so free users get 403 {code:'upgrade_required'} instead of a silent 200. (Mirror the pattern already used in messaging_router.send_message and community_router.create_post.)

MOBILE (HIGH): Update /app/mobile/src/lib/upgrade.ts to treat BOTH 402 and 403 as upgrade_required (match web lib/api.js). Example: `if (e instanceof ApiError && (e.status === 402 || e.status === 403) && e.code === 'upgrade_required') { ... }`.
Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iter87_regression.py after the follow gating fix — the only failing test is TestFreeGating::test_free_follow_user_behavior and it will pass automatically.
critical_code_review_comments: deps.require_interaction raises 403 with structured {code:'upgrade_required'} — consistent, but web/mobile need parity on the 403 branch handling (web already does, mobile does not).
follows_router.follow_org is the only community-interaction endpoint missing require_interaction(u). messaging_router, community_router (posts/comments), reviews, crew-bank etc. all gate correctly.

payments_router.payments_packages shape matches both web Pricing.jsx and mobile pricing.tsx; totals computed via package_total(pkg) = round(monthly*months*(1-discount), 2) — matches displayed /payments/packages total.
GET /boat-pros/{pro_id} returns {pro, reviews} — a wrapper, not a flat doc. If the main agent writes new tests, access viewer_hired via .pro.viewer_hired (iter87 test fixed this).

Review category validation requires ALL 4 keys {personality, skill, promptness, communication} present and 1..5. Any missing key → 400 'All categories required'. Mobile/web review forms should pre-populate all 4 inputs before submit.

Event list uses upcoming_event_predicate on ends_at (fallback starts_at) >= now_iso. System clock in this environment is already at 2026-10-03, so events dated Sept 2026 or earlier are hidden. Not a bug, but worth noting for the main agent when seeding demo events.

success_rate.frontend: web pricing flow verified visually; mobile paywall handler flagged via code review

context_for_next_testing_agent: System clock is 2026-10-03 — use December 2026 or later for new event seeds so they pass upcoming_event_predicate. /api/events accepts starts_at/ends_at (not start/end). /api/posts, /api/events are mounted at /api (no /community prefix). Message body uses `body` field, not `content`. POST /boat-pros/{id}/hire has NO JSON body — simple toggle. Review category keys: personality, skill, promptness, communication. GET /boat-pros/{id} returns {pro, reviews} wrapper. Admin content edit lives at PATCH/DELETE /api/admin/content/{entity}/{id} with entities post|discussion|comment|review|event.
rca of the issue: Free-follow gap: follows_router.follow_org never had require_interaction added when the paid-interaction gating was rolled out — the function predates the gating layer. Low-risk fix (one line). Mobile 402-only paywall: upgrade.ts was first written when only /payments/checkout and partner event-create returned 402; when require_interaction was added later with 403, the web handler was updated (lib/api.js:20 `st === 402 || st === 403`) but the mobile helper never was. Fix is a one-line condition change.
